title: Missing Antiforgery C# API Exposed
description: Missing anti-forgery token on a state-changing HTTP POST MVC action, exposing the endpoint to CSRF. Without token validation, malicious sites could trick authenticated users into submitting unwanted requests. Fix: add [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] to the POST action.
evidence: missing anti-forgery token on a state-changing HTTP POST MVC action, which exposes the endpoint to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks
extraction_notes: D4 DUAL-SEVERITY RULE (settled): severity_raw = the `Severity` column ('High'); `Original Severity` ('Medium') recorded here in notes. CWE-352 present. Count=22 is an instance count, not CVE count (no CVEs here). Owner=Sam; team=Dev from 'Dev / dev_app_1'.
